repository.name: NiakVIO
repository.description: NiakVIO-owned provider catalogue and routing policy. ProviderBase, structured DATA, owned Lego, official address discovery and validated runtime observations are the operational sources of truth. External provider repositories are not required for ordinary reconstruction or playback.

selection_policy.runtime_check: one representative provider request and at most one playable stream
selection_policy.server_accessibility: any HTTP response from a non-infrastructure provider host; DNS/connection/timeout failures remain inaccessible
selection_policy.metadata_curation: NiakVIO provider metadata and durable recognition DATA are authoritative; external duplicate declarations are not runtime inputs
enabled_manifest_order: explicit or runtime-confirmed VF providers first
explicit or runtime-confirmed VOSTFR providers second
VF/VOSTFR/French groups: resolution, health score, curation score descending
other-language group: health/quality score, resolution, curation score descending
selection_policy.content_type_inference: Anime catalogues may transport animated feature films through the movie namespace; canonical anime capability remains distinct from transport compatibility; tv remains the series request type.
selection_policy.manual_provider_priority_scope: Applied before language/quality ranking while preserving enabled providers before disabled providers.
selection_policy.provider_domain_resolution: Official hubs and public service announcements first; validated redirects and curated candidates next; bounded search fallback only in deep mode; search-only changes require repeated confirmation.
selection_policy.provider_domain_refresh_schedule: Daily lightweight validated refresh; strict code and stream publication remains deep-only.
selection_policy.duplicate_policy: reject later duplicate DATA rows once a canonical NiakVIO provider id is materialized
selection_policy.route_authority: NiakVIO durable DATA plus validated NiakVIO recognition and runtime observations

nuvio_client_compatibility.policy: accepted_ref may advance automatically only when hard and semantic runtime contract checks remain unchanged
